# Acadia To Present at the Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference


Posted on


[September](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2026/09/)[9](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2026/09/09/) ,[2026](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/2026/)


by


[Acadia Healthcare](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/about/news-media-events/author/acadia-healthcare)


Acadia Healthcare will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference on September 14. The conference is being held in Nashville, Tennessee, and Acadia’s presentation will be available on the company’s[Investors page](https://www.acadiahealthcare.com/investors/) September 14 beginning at 2:25 p.m. Central time.
